name: Missing Clone Initialization
hint: When a sprite creates a clone of itself but has no scripts started by [sbi]When I start as a clone[/sbi] or [sbi]When this sprite clicked[/sbi] events, clones will not perform any actions.
instruction: When a sprite creates a clone of itself but has no scripts started by [sbi]When I start as a clone[/sbi] or [sbi]When this sprite clicked[/sbi] events, clones will not perform any actions.[newLine]Your code has to contain one of these two blocks.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
glide (1) secs to [random position v]
create clone of [myself v] :: #ff0000 //⇦  🐛

examples.label: Possible Solution
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
glide (1) secs to [random position v]
create clone of [myself v] :: #007000 //⇦  👍

when I start as a clone :: #007000 //⇦  👍
change size by (10)
